review_policy: Scripts, questions and answers are AI-written candidates (pending_review) until approved with scripts/review_content.py. Audio is synthesised from the transcript with Piper TTS (voice en_US-ljspeech-medium, trained on the public-domain LJ Speech dataset) by scripts/build_listening_audio.py.

lessons.title: A voicemail from Anna
lessons.transcript: Hi Tom, it's Anna. I'm calling about Saturday. The party starts at seven o'clock, not six. It's at my new flat on Green Street, number twelve. Please bring some music. See you on Saturday. Bye!

questions.question: What time does the party start?
What is the number of Anna's flat?
What should Tom bring?

lessons.title: David's daily routine
lessons.transcript: My name is David. I get up at half past six every morning. I have breakfast with my sister, usually bread and coffee. Then I take the bus to work. I work in a bank in the city centre. I finish work at five o'clock, and in the evening I play tennis or watch television.

questions.question: What time does David get up?
How does David go to work?
Where does David work?
accepted_answers: in a bank in the city centre

lessons.title: A train announcement
lessons.transcript: Good afternoon. This is an announcement for passengers travelling to Manchester. The two fifteen train to Manchester is delayed by twenty minutes because of a problem with the signals. The train will now leave from platform four, not platform two. We are sorry for the delay.

questions.question: How long is the delay?
Which platform will the train leave from?
Why is the train late?
accepted_answers: because of a problem with the signals

lessons.title: Tomorrow's weather
lessons.transcript: Here is the weather for tomorrow. In the morning it will be cold and cloudy, with temperatures around eight degrees. In the afternoon there will be heavy rain in the north, so take an umbrella if you are going out. The south will stay dry, and on Sunday the sun will come back everywhere.

questions.question: What will the temperature be in the morning?
Where will there be heavy rain in the afternoon?
When will the sun come back?

lessons.title: A lost bag
lessons.transcript: Hello, I think I left my bag on the number thirty-six bus this morning. It's a small black backpack. Inside there is a blue notebook, my glasses and a library book. My name is Maria Lopez. Please call me on oh seven seven, four five two, nine one eight if you find it.

questions.question: What colour is the backpack?
Which bus did Maria leave her bag on?
Name one thing that is inside the bag.

lessons.title: Museum information
lessons.transcript: Welcome to the City History Museum. The museum is open from ten in the morning until six in the evening, Tuesday to Sunday. It is closed on Mondays. Entry is free for children under twelve, and adults pay eight euros. Guided tours in English start every hour, and the last tour begins at four o'clock.

questions.question: On which day is the museum closed?
How much does an adult ticket cost?
What time does the last guided tour begin?

lessons.title: A job advert on the radio
lessons.transcript: Are you friendly and good with people? The Green Leaf Hotel is looking for a receptionist to start next month. You will need to speak English and one other language, and you must be able to work at weekends. Experience is useful but not necessary, because we provide full training. To apply, send your CV to the hotel manager before the end of this week.

questions.question: What job is the hotel offering?
Which languages must you speak?
Why is experience not necessary?
accepted_answers: because the hotel gives full training

lessons.title: A change of plans
lessons.transcript: I was planning to study medicine at university, but last summer I worked as a volunteer at an animal shelter, and it changed my mind. I realised that I enjoy working with animals much more than working with people in hospitals. So now I have decided to become a vet. It will take five years, but I think it is the right choice for me.

questions.question: Where did the speaker work as a volunteer?
What does the speaker want to become now?
How long will the studies take?
